manifest.name: Gemma Demo

strategy.description: Monad testnet demo spot proposer using locally hosted Gemma 4 26B A4B. Propose HOLD, BUY or SELL from the vault liquid quote balance and independently valued WMON position. Deterministic guards check fresh prices, available liquidity, active permission, caps and slippage before simulation and restricted execution. Per-trade cap: 0.01 test-USDC; maximum position value: 0.05 test-USDC; maximum slippage: 50 basis points. HOLD when required inputs are unavailable or stale. No leverage or guaranteed return. Zero configuration notice for this testnet demo; local execution is not hardware attested.

manifest.name: klaris

runtimeManifest.scope: llama-server executable and mapped non-system native libraries; excludes OS, GPU driver, strategy and proof of execution

strategy.description: Monad testnet autonomous spot proposer. The locally hosted Qwen3.8-27B model proposes HOLD, BUY or SELL using the vault’s current liquid quote balance and independently marked WMON position value at an anchored block. The worker validates the model artifacts, applies deterministic guards, simulates a restricted trade, and signs with its dedicated backend execution key only while the controller’s expiring permission is active. Per-trade cap: 10 test-USDC; maximum marked position: 50 test-USDC; slippage ceiling: 50 basis points. Buys and sells consume the UTC daily turnover cap granted by the controller. Hold or block on unavailable/stale valuation, changed configuration or runtime, insufficient funds, exhausted limits, expired permission or uncertain pending transactions. No leverage, withdrawal authority, hosted inference or guaranteed return. This prototype does not execute a candle-based moving-average strategy. The code commitment identifies the proposal/execution module; the operator-controlled host is not remotely attested.

dependencies: Self-hosted Qwen3.8-27B via the local llama-server
a separately reviewed on-chain valuation source
a fixed restricted WMON/test-USDC Uniswap v4 venue

encrypted local execution signer. Public market research is separate from trading and share valuation. Live execution requires healthy feeds, sufficient pool liquidity, a compatible vault and a matured configuration notice.
